landing.heroTitle: Your transcript already contains a plan. We read it and build the steps.
landing.heroBody: Nava reads your Algerian transcript, matches you against 20+ curated scholarships, and turns the result into a dated plan with a document checklist you can actually follow.
landing.step1Body: Photograph your transcript or diploma. It stays private and is used only to build your plan.
landing.step2Body: Deterministic rules score every scholarship against your real grades, level, field and funding need.
landing.step3Body: Get a back-planned timeline, a document checklist, a draft letter and a pre-submission check.
landing.trust1: We never invent a deadline, a fee or a test minimum. Unverified facts are marked and treated as unknown.
landing.trust2: We never promise admission or estimate your chances.
landing.trust3: Your documents are yours. Delete them and the derived data goes with them.
landing.faq1a: Yes for everything in this demo: matching, timeline, checklist, drafts, checks and exports.
landing.faq2q: Do you know the real deadlines?
landing.faq2a: Not yet. The catalog ships with structure only. Every date and requirement is marked unverified until a curator checks the official page.
landing.faq3a: Arabic, French and English, with full right-to-left layout in Arabic.

chat.subtitle: Post-bac orientation — no forms, no uploads
chat.bot.greeting: Hi, I'm Nava. In about 5 minutes I'll help you find the Algerian faculty or school that fits you. I only use your answers to build your options, and you can change anything.
chat.bot.howItWorks: Three steps: you tell me about your bac and what you like, I match you against real Algerian formations, you decide. Ready?
chat.bot.welcomeBack: Welcome back. Let's continue where we left off.
chat.bot.stream: Which bac stream did you take?
chat.bot.streamOption: Which technical option? (for example: mechanical, civil, electrical, process engineering)
chat.bot.average: What was your bac average out of 20?
chat.bot.estimatePrompt: That's fine — what average do you expect? I'll mark it as an estimate until your real result replaces it.
chat.bot.year: Which year did you take the bac?
chat.bot.wilaya: Which wilaya do you live in? I'll use it to show nearby options.
chat.bot.interests: What do you enjoy, or what do you imagine yourself doing one day? Write freely, in any language.
chat.bot.tagsFound: Here is what I understood ({count} tags). Remove what's wrong, add what's missing.
chat.bot.workStyle: Do you prefer working with people, machines, data or ideas?
chat.bot.studyLength: How long are you ready to study?
chat.bot.distance: How far from home are you ready to study?
chat.bot.budget: What monthly support do you have from your family?
chat.bot.language: In which language do you prefer to study?
chat.bot.wishes: Have you already written your wishes?
chat.bot.abroad: Would you also like to see options abroad, next to the Algerian ones? You can change this later.
chat.bot.confirmIntro: Here is everything I know. Confirm, or edit something.
chat.chip.freeOnly: I need free or public options only
chat.doneNote: Confirm your profile to see your options.
chat.ph.wishes: One wish per line, for example: 1. Computer science at USTHB
chat.error.unusual_average: That looks unusual — bac averages are between 0 and 20. Let's try again.
chat.error.invalid_average: I couldn't read that. A bac average looks like 14.35.
chat.error.invalid_value: That answer doesn't fit. Try one of the options.
chat.error.generic: I couldn't process that. Try again.

plan.doc.bac_certificate.title: Bac certificate (original)
plan.doc.bac_certificate.why: Proof you passed the baccalauréat — asked at every inscription.
plan.doc.bac_certificate.how: Collect the original from your high school. Ask for extra certified copies (copies conformes) while you are there.
plan.doc.birth_certificate.title: Birth certificate (copie conforme)
plan.doc.birth_certificate.why: Required for university registration and student cards.
plan.doc.birth_certificate.how: Order a recent copy (copie intégrale) from the civil registry of your birth commune, then have certified copies made.
plan.doc.photos.title: Identity photos
plan.doc.photos.why: For registration files, transport cards and exams.
plan.doc.photos.how: Standard 35×45 mm set from any photographer; keep at least 8.
plan.doc.residence.title: Certificate of residence
plan.doc.residence.why: Some universities ask it for housing and scholarship files.
plan.doc.residence.how: Ask it at your APC (commune) — a same-day document, sometimes with a small stamp fee.
plan.doc.attestation_reussite.title: Attestation of success
plan.doc.attestation_reussite.why: The bac result sheet you received with the result; some inscriptions ask for it while the certificate is printed.
plan.doc.attestation_reussite.how: Download or collect it from your high school or thebac.dz with your exam number.
plan.doc.fiche_voeux.title: Fiche de vœux confirmation
plan.doc.fiche_voeux.why: The ranked wish list you submit on the official orientation platform.
plan.doc.fiche_voeux.how: Prepare it in the Fiche de vœux tab, review the order, then submit on the official portal and keep the confirmation receipt.
